_doc: Per-manager profile for the precommit tool slot. The bind step (SETUP.md step 8e) picks the profile matching tools.precommit, copies template_ref into the project, substitutes {{LINT_COMMAND}}/{{TYPECHECK_COMMAND}}/{{TEST_COMMAND}}, and emits activation_command as a user instruction. See SETUP.md Phase 3 step 8e.

required_fields.config_filename: string - path written into the project repo, e.g. 'lefthook.yml', '.husky/pre-commit', '.pre-commit-config.yaml', '.simple-git-hooks.json'
required_fields.template_ref: string - path relative to _core/project-template/ (i.e. carries the precommit/ prefix), e.g. 'precommit/lefthook.yml.template'; SETUP.md step 8e copies _core/project-template/<template_ref>
required_fields.activation_command: string - the command the USER runs to activate (emitted as instruction, never executed)

optional_fields.runtime_note: string - runtime/toolchain the user must have (shown in install-hint)
optional_fields._skip_install: bool - true for 'none' (write nothing, still run gate cleanup)

lefthook.runtime_note: standalone binary (brew/scoop/winget/npm/go) - no language runtime required

husky.activation_command: npm install --save-dev husky && npm pkg set scripts.prepare=husky && npm run prepare
husky.runtime_note: requires Node + package.json (activation rides the npm prepare script)
